fault_catalog.title: None — Clean WignerFlow
fault_catalog.description: All symmetry, momentum, cutoff, and steric guards enabled.

fault_catalog.title: F1 — Anisotropic Scale (Breaks G1)
fault_catalog.description: Scales x, y, z unevenly by (1.045, 0.955, 1.015), breaking 3D rotation symmetry.

fault_catalog.title: F2 — Pole Angle Glitch (Breaks G1)
fault_catalog.description: Injects an angle discontinuity when a pair aligns with the +/-y axis.

fault_catalog.title: F3 — Chiral Cross Product (Breaks G2)
fault_catalog.description: Adds r x v: proper 3D rotations still pass, but mirror reflections flip sign.

fault_catalog.title: F4 — Unweighted Centering (Breaks G3)
fault_catalog.description: Centers coordinates with 1/N instead of atom masses, leaking net linear momentum.

fault_catalog.title: F5 — Fixed Box & Hard Cutoff (Breaks G5)
fault_catalog.description: Rotates atoms without rotating the periodic box and introduces a sharp cutoff jump.

fault_catalog.title: F6 — Non-Conservative Curl (Breaks G6)
fault_catalog.description: Adds a rotational force field that creates non-zero work around a closed loop.

fault_catalog.title: F7 — Flying Ice Cube (Breaks G7)
fault_catalog.description: Damps internal bond vibrations and transfers kinetic energy into whole-molecule drift.

fault_catalog.title: F8 — Steric Clash Without Prior (Breaks G8)
fault_catalog.description: Disables RepulsionPrior and places two non-bonded atoms at 52% of van der Waals contact.

fault_catalog.title: F9 — Zero Thermal Noise (Breaks G9)
fault_catalog.description: Removes stochastic flow noise and damps velocities so temperature collapses.

fault_catalog.title: F10 — Extreme Bond Strain (Breaks G10)
fault_catalog.description: Pulls bonds far from equilibrium so 1-step Euler and 2-step Heun diverge.

datasets.pain_point: Filter false-positive docked poses via CompScore & tau-RAMD before running RB-FEP.

datasets.pain_point: Multi-replica OpenBPMD CompScore & PoseBusters triage on CPU.

datasets.title: ATLAS Standardized All-Atom Protein MD Database (Vander Meersche et al. NAR 2024)
datasets.pain_point: Rapid apo/holo pocket flexibility & pose-entropy check before ensemble docking.

datasets.title: LIBE / Figshare Carbonate + Additive Electrolyte MD (Spotte-Smith / Persson Group)
datasets.pain_point: Screen new additives for Li+ solvation (CAGS) & Cluster-NE sigma_cNE before 50 ns MD / AIMD.

datasets.title: Electrolyte Design / Non-Aqueous Li-Salt Solvation Trajectories (Fong, Self & Persson)
datasets.pain_point: Catch neutral CIP/AGG conductivity mirages via Inverse Haven Ionicity (sigma_cNE / sigma_NE).

datasets.title: MD17 / rMD17 & Liquid Argon Coarse-Stride Benchmark Trajectories (Fu et al. TMLR 2023)
datasets.pain_point: Audit 50-fs neural checkpoints for RDF L1, COM leakage, and flow epistemic spread on CPU.
